# Backspace Fork 1.15.5

## Changes

- **Instance Administration & Spaces:** Added an instance setting (`spaceCreationOpen`) in the **Registration** admin panel to allow or block non-admin users from creating new spaces (`POST /api/spaces` returns `403 space_creation_disabled` for non-admins when disabled, while instance administrators remain exempt).
- **Real-time UI Sync:** Exposed `spaceCreationOpen` on `GET /api/instance/info` and added the `instance_settings_updated` WebSocket broadcast so connected desktop and mobile clients immediately hide or restore the create-space actions (leaving only the join-space flow for non-admin users when disabled).
